blocks.translation:
• To the purchaser: Read before use.
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children younger than the specified age under any circumstances.
• This product contains small parts. Take care that young children do not swallow them, as they pose a choking hazard.
• Do not use this product near the ear. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• Do not put fingers or other objects into moving parts. You may get pinched and injured.
• This product contains electronic parts; people with pacemakers should take care.
• Improper use of batteries can cause heating, bursting, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Insert batteries with the correct +− (plus/minus) polarity.
• After playing, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into a fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a physician. If it contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of this product or batteries, follow your local municipal waste disposal regulations.

blocks.translation:
• This product contains delicate electronic components. Do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places that become very hot or very cold. Throw away plastic packaging immediately after opening.
• Do not place this product on resin sofas, seats, tiles, or similar surfaces. Prolonged contact may cause color transfer.
• Do not strongly pull or bend movable or attached parts in directions they are not meant to go.
• Some voice lines may have different intonation or may be hard to hear because of the product’s characteristics.
